This section contains lecture notes, examples, exercises, and supplementary
materials for *Mathematics in the Modern World*.

These are personal teaching materials prepared by RJ Nieto. Unless expressly
stated otherwise, they should not be treated as official publications or
policies of Bulacan State University.

## Course materials

Materials will be organised by topic and teaching week.

1. The language of mathematics
2. Patterns and mathematical reasoning
3. Logic and proof
4. Mathematics of graphs
5. Mathematics of finance
6. Voting and apportionment
7. Data, uncertainty, and decision-making

## Availability

Materials will be added as they are prepared and reviewed.
